just a short note about what scents i imagine these two to have-

Phainon – grassy wind (?), old ink, smelling him feels like burying ones nose in sun-soaked fabric.

Mydei – iron-rusty like blood, a hint of pomegranate and firewood, maybe a bit of baked bread

based on my thread fic with Phainon's POV added!

They don't have full-blown sex in this fic, but they do indirectly agree to it for future ruts and letting the other knot them when the day comes.

After a few seconds of taking in the scene in his bedroom, Mydei very carefully steps out, slowly shutting the door behind him.

Staring numbly at the chipped pattern on the wall in front doesn’t remove the image of Phainon slumped on his bed, heady and feverish from a rut, from his mind.

No, perhaps Mydei had been hallucinating. Hallucinations did not simply come upon him on a whim, but it wasn’t a new-

A deep breath has him smell the sharp scent coming out in jagged waves through the gap beneath his door – of freshly trimmed grasses and printed and ink and a hint of sun.

Undeniably an alpha in rut – specifically Phainon, with his scent amplified by the intensity of his affliction.

Mydei shuts his eyes.

Massages his nose.

Cutting off the visual input only makes him more aware of the pained, smothered groans coming from inside, the aggressive waves of pheromones – of Phainon inside his room.

Deep breaths do not help.

Mydei opens the door again – just by a crack. The sight of the Heir on his bed assaults him again – pale hair sticking to his forehead with sweat, his coat hanging off the edge of the bed, his shirt torn wide and open, exposing his sculpted-

Phainon hears it this time, his hazy eyes flicking up to meet Mydei’s through the crack in the door – the blue of his irises nearly swallowed by black.

He barely registers the heat in them when-

“Get out!” Phainon snarls.

-Mydei shuts the door.

The first thing that comes to mind is utter rage. How dare an alpha invade his space and ask him to get out on top of it? It just takes about every ounce of Mydei’s rational thought to not storm in there and throw the shithead out.

No – he needed to make sense of this all, first.

Phainon was indeed in rut. And Phainon was indeed in his room.

Mydei just did not understand why he had sought out another alpha’s room of all places for refuge.

Aglaea spends a generous amount of time staring back at Mydei, presumably waiting for him to explain his presence.

“I know you have already seen it.”

The goldweaver blinks and then she gazes off into the distance, reading through thousands of strands of threads to see what Mydei was talking about.

And then the slightest hint of confusion mars her features.

“This is…”

“Explain.” Mydei waves in the direction of his dwellings. He did not intend to sound so blunt with her but a Phainon in rut was not in his list of situations he had to deal with.

After a minute of contemplation, Aglaea sighs.

“Before I answer, Mydeimos, would you like to try and come up with an answer yourself?”

Mydei feels his eyebrow twitch.

“I do not know the Deliverer for as long as you do, Aglaea.”

“I’m aware. It simply is easier to give an answer to one who has explored their own answers first.”

Mydei looks up at the building, at his window which was currently shut, hiding the Deliverer from the rest of the world.

“He doesn’t happen to be an omega pretending to be an alpha, is he?”

It sounded utterly ridiculous but it also was the most plausible explanation for him to be in Mydei’s room.

“Did he smell like one, Mydei?”

“…”

Grasses flying along with crisp winds, fabrics soaked in the sun – the scent aggressive and seeking nothing but ownership-

No. Absolutely not. Phainon wasn’t even showing any nesting behaviour on top of it.

“ Get out!!

And…that.

The other possibility was worse to imagine, as unrealistic as it was.

“Does he…has he mistaken me for an omega then?”

Aglaea only answers him with a withering look.

No. Mydei’s presence as an alpha was too imposing, to say the least – to the extent that even other alphas would offer their silent deference. Ever since he had set foot in the city, only Phainon had been unaffected by it.

“Phainon is a unique case, to put it mildly.” Aglaea finally relents, “He has had quite a troubled experience with his reality as an alpha.”

“…Something to do with his village?” he offers. It wasn’t unheard of for traumas to condition deeply harmful tendencies into an alpha, completely disrupt their rut cycles and pheromone management. Especially with losses so devastating suffered at an age so young.

Mydei could have ended up like him too, had it not been for the older alphas in the detachment present to guide him.

“I do not know what transpired in the time between the destruction of Aedes Elysiae and his joining the Chrysos Heirs.” Aglaea seats herself on a delicate throne of golden threads spun out of thin air, “I have just gleaned enough to understand Phainon presented as an alpha when he had no one to guide him – he worked through those emotions and instincts with the horrors of his bereavement still fresh in his mind. With the way he presents himself to the rest of us – no one would ever be able to tell. He does have frightening amounts of control over himself.”

“Except his ruts.”

“The time when alphas have the least amount of control over themselves.” Mydei’s gaze follows a lone string of gold that she twirls around her finger, “That is when the façade of the perfect ‘Deliverer’ begins to crumble.”

“What ‘perfect’ are you talking about – that fool can’t even climb on a dromas without getting kicked away first.”

Aglaea gives him an impassive blink.

“Well, whatever it is, his ruts are consequently more erratic. No pattern, no warning and the abnormal aggression and volatility…makes him a danger for the others.”

“…”

It makes Mydei think about the Phainon in his room, and overlooking how he had howled at him to get out…he did not seem anything like it in his eyes.

Phainon looked docile, if anything.

“Phainon has strived to conceal this from the rest…he would completely disappear for a week and at least one of us needs to know why and that is the only reason he shared it with me.”

“Does he not seek the company of omegas? I…am sure there would be plenty who would readily give themselves…” Mydei trails off. Phainon was a powerful warrior, held himself relatively well in public and was undeniably blessed with a great physique and beautiful features.

Any omega or even a beta would want him.

So why was the mere thought of such a logical reasoning filling Mydei’s mouth with a sour taste?

“He stays away from them – he fears his lack of restraint too much to be around them.”

So that HKS just opted to suffer through it alone?

“Wouldn’t an alpha like me make it worse?” Mydei points a finger at himself, “And yet that fool is rolling around in my sheets that obviously smell like me.”

“That is the most intriguing thing about it, actually.” Aglaea tilts her head and Mydei feels the very mild hint of interest in her expression, “He gets even worse around alphas when he’s close to a rut; even picking up the slightest scent of one sets him off. Despite being a beta, sometimes I would make him snap because I lingered too long around Cipher. He has never fared well around them until…you.”

“That makes no sense.” Mydei deadpans.

“Your behaviour does not follow established logic either, Mydeimos.”

Mydei blinks.

“What.”

“For an alpha of your quality, you are not affected by the presence of another taking over your den.”

“I am affected – that’s why I came to you-”

“I shall rephrase.” Aglaea leans forward, a glint in her lime eyes, “You are affected within reason. You are not agitated by instinct – you are here out of worry for Phainon, not because you want to rip him into two from an alpha’s wounded pride.”

Her words leave him frozen mid-thought.

“Did you not even notice it?” Aglaea continues, neutrally merciless, “His scent – the scent of an alpha who has been rivalling you ever since you met, your only match, your only equal – a threat to your dominance. This scent is all over your territory, you smelt it first hand and the only thing that bothered you was your conscious understanding of decorum – the fact that it logically should not be that way. Any other alpha in your place would have attempted to bite Phainon’s throat out without question.”

Mydei manages – just barely – to not have his mouth hang open like a fool.

Aglaea leans back, a smugly satisfied look briefly flashing across her face. She was thoroughly enjoying this.

Old inks printed into yellow parchments. Crisp sunshine clinging to dried clothes. The scent of dew kissing lush grasses. This was what Phainon always smelled like, a scent that Mydei had always found pleasant – calming even, with time.

This was an alpha they were talking about here. This was something that shouldn’t have happened.

How many times had Phainon been near him? How many times had they exchanged blows, soaked in heat and adrenaline and pheromones? Not once had it evoked that natural aggressive posturing in Mydei that one would expect from a fellow alpha, made his innards coil at a scent he should have found unbearably pungent, made him bare his teeth like an unrestrained animal.

If Mydei bristled, it was due to the easy confidence with which Phainon taunted him. If he growled, it was to reply to his challenging jeers, inviting him to yet another nonsensical contest. If he battled him, his blood boiling with the urge to dominate, it was only to wipe that annoying smirk off that imbecile’s face.

Because it was Phainon. Phainon who would recklessly slap his back in public, Phainon who would walk around with that sunlit smile on his stupid face, Phainon who would strut around their impromptu arenas with the arrogance of a warrior who could never be bested, Phainon whose scent would make Mydei want to bury his face into the crook of his neck and inhale more.

How had Mydei not realized it before? Had it all been drowned out by the static of their unceasing rivalry?

“It is mere conjecture-” Aglaea prepares to gently hammer the last nail, “-but if Phainon’s scent sparks no fight within you, it is possible that he feels something similar towards yours.”

“He asked me to get out.”

“And yet it is your scent that he seeks solace in, Mydeimos. You are his equal, so he does not fear being subjugated by you. What might help is that you establish the same. That you are not someone he can hurt.”

How even was a rutting alpha to be handled? He didn’t know and he was absolutely sure Phainon didn’t know shit either.

Gripping the knob with his hand, Mydei allows himself a few seconds. It was obvious his rut had intensified; the scent louder and far more volatile.

He had sent off his soldiers soon after learning about the intruder, but how had Phainon even broken in without a fight breaking out?

Well, all that could be damned; all Mydei knew was that he had to wing it once he stepped in – answers could come later.

The second the door creaks open, Mydei sees Phainon jump, wildly sitting up.

A mess. An utter mess that man was – white hair tousled and sticky with sweat, blue eyes wide and wanting, a deep flush colouring his cheeks and bleeding into his shoulders. Tension burnt into every inch of his frame, a thin sheen of sweat covering his skin, his breaths uneven and restless.

A sight utterly revolting for another alpha to behold.

Mydei only feels heat pool into his stomach.

As he closes the door behind him, Phainon tenses like a coiled spring, jaw clenched and eyes glazed and guttural.

“The fuck are you looking at me like that for?” Mydei goads and something flashes in Phainon’s eyes.

He moves – too fast and Mydei only heard a crazed snarl before he feels him crash into him, both landing on the floor.

Phainon was easier to fight without a sword in his hand.

“Deliverer – get a hold of yourself-” Phainon’s fist connects with his cheek before he grabs Mydei’s hair and slams his head against the floor.

But the bastard being in rut made him a whole new handful to deal with. It was only Mydei's absurd physiology that has the blow reel him away from his senses for less than a second before he comes to.

Not without the newfound urge to rip Phainon’s throat out with his teeth, as Aglaea had told him he typically should want to do.

Mydei wrestles him around a bit before managing to pin him down on the floor, struggling to maintain the position with how Phainon kept thrashing beneath him, clawing at his arms and attempting to bite him, even.

The scent of his rut surrounds them, sharp and angry and uncontrollable and for the first time, Mydei feels relieved that his scent did not set off his own aggression as one would expect. This would have been a bloodbath. This shithead was so, so goddamn lucky it was Mydei handling him.

Phainon says something, voice too garbled for him to interpret. Mydei tries to pin his hands down and immediately Phainon attempts to drive his knee into his side.

Maybe he should still sock him in the face once for good measure.

“G…et….way! Get away!” he finally hears and Mydei glares down at his face. Phainon’s chest heaves wildly, his eyes almost feral until Mydei catches the tinge of panic in them.

And he sets his foot down.

“No.”

“Mydei!!”

“These are my dwellings. How dare you hole yourself up in here and then order me to leave?”

Phainon looks almost pained at that and attempts to throw him off again.

“And I know there is comfort you seek with my scent – that’s why you’re here.”

“You shouldn’t be around me – I can’t control myself-!”

Something – likely insanity – compels Mydei to lean closer to the struggling Phainon, tilting his head to bare his neck to him, a mere inch away from his nose.

Phainon feels so, so tense in his arms. And Mydei waits, not loosening his grip on him even for a second, even when Phainon goes utterly still beneath him, even when his pulse hammers violently beneath his grip on his wrists.

“Shut up for once, Deliverer and listen.” He orders, keeping his neck bared. It was a risky, risky game that Mydei was playing – leaving himself open yet refusing to completely submit.

And he waits.

Minutes tick.

And then, almost as if fearful, Phainon’s nose presses against Mydei’s throat, against his scent gland so temptingly offered.

And he waits.

Waits until Phainon’s breathing gradually grows stable, his pulse steadily easing into a rhythm with the tension slowly dissipating from his limbs. He hears him inhale his scent in, and exhale out a low, barely concealed whine.

“I am not here to hurt you, Deliverer.” Mydei speaks, softly. What he gave was not submission but it was sufficient, “Nor can you do anything to me.”

“You…you don’t know what I could do – what I have thought of-”

“And what have you done to me?” Mydei turns his head, staring down at Phainon, the fight dulled from his gaze and his voice, “With what resolve could you do anything – I managed to pin you down and immobilize you, I bared my neck to you, made it easy for you to bite my throat out and what did you do?”

Phainon’s eyes widen, “I – you shouldn’t have to deal with this-”

“I’m fine, Phainon.” Mydei straightens up, eliciting a choked noise from him, “I’m here by my own will – no one, not even you, gets to browbeat me into doing anything.”

“You…Mydei, you shouldn’t-”

“You need to help me help you, Deliverer-”

“Mydei, you shouldn’t sit on me like this.” Phainon gushes, his voice almost trembling – so unlike its usual clear, stable tone. Mydei frowns.

“What-?”

“You…” Phainon’s eyelids flutter as he strives to look elsewhere, “You’re sitting on-”

“…”

Mydei looks down, taking in their current position, with him straddling Phainon’s-

And he shuts his eyes, exhaling sharply through his nose before promptly standing up.

Phainon remains sprawled on the floor while Mydei gets off him, slightly twisting his body to the side and throwing his arm over his face. Mydei watches him like that for a while – Phainon’s shirt had torn even more during their scuffle, exposing more of his chest. Shaky breaths were spilling out of his parted lips and he slightly curls his legs at feeling the prince’s gaze on him and Mydei’s hands tighten into fists at his sides.

Phainon’s scent hangs thick in the air – it no longer radiated off him in haphazard waves but it still clung to him like a second skin and Mydei’s feels his own pheromones respond to it, his control slipping to let a whisper of faint rust and pomegranate bleed from his flesh.

Phainon pulls back his arm, eyes darting up towards Mydei before raking all over him.

Mydei holds back a swear under his breath. It wasn’t enough that this fool was barely more than a hound at the moment – he also had to look utterly ravishing as well. Mydei would have probably taken him right then and there had he not remembered that it was Phainon currently in a rut.

Glaring down at him for a while, Mydei almost holds his hand out to help him before deciding against that and just scooping Phainon up in his arms, who lets out an indignant whine as he is tossed carelessly onto the bed.

Mydei lays beside Phainon, rigid and unmoving – not touching, not speaking. Each minute that drags its feet only turns the air clammier; thick with the strain of what was to unfold, or never would.

At least Phainon’s breath sounded stabler than before, even if the man managed to stare at him simultaneously like an animal cornered and a prey left starving.

“Deliverer.”

“Mmn?”

“…What would you like to do?”

Phainon blinks, slow and weak.

“I…what am I supposed to-”

“Do you want me to leave?”

“No!” Phainon nearly shouts, throwing his hand out to splay it over Mydei’s chest. Warm and clammy with sweat and desperation.

Well, at least he made physical contact.

Mydei shakes his head and pulls him closer. Phainon tenses again and he waits, patiently, as he gradually eases himself into his arms, gingerly tucking his face into his neck.

“Alphas in rut need an omega companion to help them through it.”

“…I know.”

“But you want nothing to do with them. It is only my presence that you tolerate.”

“Mhmn.”

“…And I’m not an omega.”

He hears a pointed sniff against his scent gland, “I can tell, Mydeimos.”

This was going to be a long day. Mydei huffs and stares up at the ceiling. He obviously knew what an alpha needed, he just didn’t know how to personally fulfill said need.

He feels a kiss against his throat and shuts his eyes; the low thrum of desire that wells up within him was undeniable. Absently, his hand delves into Phainon’s hair – it felt limp and sweaty and strange to touch – so different from how soft and fluffy it usually looked.

“Mydei…”

His hands begin to paw around his torso.

“I’m sorry – I don’t know why; this wasn’t how – shit, you must be hating this-”

“Deliverer, I’m fine with it.”

Phainon freezes in his arms and Mydei tightens them around him by instinct. Doubt rarely crept up on him but Mydei wasn’t sure if this was the right thing to do, how much of it was his own desire taking over the reins. He didn’t want Phainon to be alone in the wreck of it all but he didn’t want to be wrong either.

But Mydei pushes on, nonetheless.

“Take me as your mate for this.”

It feels like a snap – the way the scent enveloping them turns sharper in a split second before oddly dropping and then rising again.

“No.” Phainon rasps, “Mating – no, I can’t…just no. That is the one thing I won’t do.”

“Why?” Mydei asks after a pause, gently. He couldn’t afford to agitate him further, “It should give you some relief, at the very least.”

“No, I don’t think that would work, Mydei-”

“I know it’s different – it won’t be what it’s like with an omega-”

“That’s not it, Mydei.” Phainon squeezes his eyes shut, “These ruts…they have always been a fight. I slip away and become something I can’t control, I can’t recognize – that I fear. I haven’t had a single one that I didn’t practically claw myself out of. Just minutes ago, I attacked you. What if I do that again – what if I hurt you?”

“But you’re fine, right now. You’re doing well, are you not, Deliverer?”

“I am. It…isn’t supposed to be like this.” His eyes flutter open and his hands travel over his chest again, almost as if in awe, “Perhaps it’s because you are here, but I still don’t know – you’re just offering yourself and – I don’t know how to handle that.”

Phainon slings his leg over Mydei’s waist, wrapping himself tighter around him.

“And…it’s not about you being an alpha or substituting for an omega – before everything else, you are Mydei to me. That’s how I wanted it to be, that’s how it was and this fucking rut just takes that away.”

Mydei’s fingers find Phainon’s jaw before slowly trialing upward, brushing over his eyelids as he closes his eyes before pushing away the damp bangs from his forehead to press a kiss against it.

“I’ll still be your Mydei, Deliverer – nothing that you do to me will take that away.”

Phainon looks up at him – a frown still lingered on his features, but he doesn’t argue, doesn’t pull away and Mydei understands that to an extent, he at least believed him.

“…Next time.” Phainon finally speaks after a long beat, “I believe you – I don’t believe I can stop being entirely afraid just yet. It…won’t go away that easily.”

“…”

“Would you still stay with me?”

“Do you see me running anywhere?”

A pause and then a tired smile appears on Phainon’s face, which instantly gets replaced by surprise when Mydei moves to grab his jaw, forcing him to stay in place.

“But don’t you get ahead of yourself, you HKS-” he lets affection bleed into his goading and Phainon’s eyes endearingly widen, “I’m not submitting to you in any manner – you have some nerve, having me booked for your next rut as well.”

“…”

“I shall have you return the favour two-fold when I have my rut next. And don’t you think I’d be anything like you; just be satisfied with cuddling like this.”

Phainon blinks slowly. Looks elsewhere for a bit, as if he was only just registering the consequences being promised to him. And then looks back at him.

“Ok.”

“…”

Well, Mydei hadn’t been expecting that.

“You agreed quite fast.” Considering his current state, Mydei had expected him to at least bare his teeth at him – most alphas did not take kindly to having other alphas fuck them.

“Well, something’s telling me you want this more than me.”

“Fuck you.” Mydei shoves at him, but Phainon only clings closer; the grin that forms on his face lifts a weight off his chest, “You were the one who went and stink-bombed my entire room, you little shit – I had to make an exception because you made yourself my headache.”

“I don’t stink.”

“You do.”

“You like how I smell.” Phainon leans in, gaze drilling into him, “I see how you stare at my neck after our spars, when I get too close.”

Mydei mumbles out a few curses in his mother tongue, but his aggression simply could not hold out anymore.

“How is it?”

Mydei stares at the pile of pillows and blankets Phainon had arranged in an oval shape on the bed. With time wearing on, he had eventually started giving in to and exploring some of his softer instincts as an alpha, one of which was preparing a good nest for his mate. And he had spent a considerable amount of time rubbing his wrists against the cushions before covering it all up with his coat and shirt.

Once Phainon was done, he had turned towards Mydei for his opinion.

Mydei looks up from the ‘nest’ meeting his wide, expectant eyes.

“A bit shit, really. Any omega would see this and walk out on you.”

Phainon glares at him.

“You – I worked hard on this you know?”

“You did?” Mydei hums, biting back a grin at seeing his indignance, “Fine. It is amazing, Lord Phainon. I would turn to no other place to spend my heats in.”

“You are a gigantic prick.” Phainon pushes at him and Mydei grabs him and pulls him into a kiss.

Which was probably not the wisest thing to do to a currently ‘very horny but doesn’t want to fuck’ alpha but Mydei’s room and bedding was going to smell like this scoundrel for weeks so he could make him suffer some payback for it.

Mydei moves to settle into the ‘nest’ when he feels strong arms wrap around him and lift him up. He almost snarls but stops himself, staying quiet as Phainon gently lays him on the nest and tucks his clothes around him. As an alpha, instinct made Mydei bristle at being handled like this, but the sight of Phainon looking so pleased by himself douses it.

“How do you feel?” he asks.

“So safe and secure and protected. Thank you, my alpha.” Mydei deadpans.

“Do you ever consider being nicer?”

“I am being nice; that’s why I’m letting you get away with all this.” Mydei shifts, letting Phainon drape himself over him like a protective cover.

In retrospect, perhaps Mydei didn’t quite mind being dragged into this mess.

What was a rut really supposed to be?

Phainon never had anyone to really tell him about it.

His throat burns.

He had no companion during his travels around Amphoreus. He belonged nowhere, and everything that belonged to him had long been reduced to a pile of soulless, grey ash, in the jaws of flames he had been too weak to douse.

He had only just eviscerated the swathe of titankin that he had been ambushed by.

When Phainon had presented as an alpha, he had only just barely made it out of a bloody battle.

Just made it out. Barely. The lacerations on his body stung like fire, the bruises littered all over ached like he was about to break in pieces any second.

“I didn’t say no.” Phainon gives a light nip at his neck to shut him up, “I don’t have any regrets either – it’s just…I said yes so easily. Being an alpha and…”

“…”

Phainon gives a small lick against Mydei’s throat, tasting the salt of it and feels him slightly shudder.

He wasn’t supposed to be this way. Offer himself up so easily.

Mydei’s hand presses flat against his back, rubbing a slow circle against it and Phainon stills at the low vibration that he feels against his chest and nuzzles against him even more.

He wasn’t supposed to enjoying this. Falling so easily in the arms of another like this. Melting to the sound of Mydei’s crooning like this. Eating up his moans like he did.

“I wasn’t raised to be a proper one and now I don’t know – every time I feel like I understand why it is this way…it just ends up being different and making no sense.”

“I am not too different now, am I? Which alpha in my position would tolerate this in the slightest?”

“That’s why I told you – you don’t-”

“I’m not putting up with it.” Mydei brushes his lips against his forehead, “It’s…not bad. I can’t defy every little aspect of my biological instincts, but I was not expecting a little shit like you would aggravate it so little.”

“Weren’t you slamming me against the floor just a few hours ago?”

“You were trying to kill me, you HKS! You should be glad it was just you – anyone else and I would have cracked their skull open.”

Phainon mulls over that in silence for a while.

“So…I’m special to you.”

“If you decide to keep bringing it up like a pest, I will toss you out of the window, Deliverer.”

“Lord Phainon! Norma only wants you to feed her the mud!”

As he tries to shape a palmful of red soil into a clump, he catches sight of Mydei in his periphery and his breath involuntarily hitches.

It had been a few days since his rut had ended.

Things had gone back to normal, as they always did.

Phainon was out in the golden streets again, back as the perfect Deliverer he was known as. As if nothing had happened.

The warmth of Mydei’s body still lingered on him.

Mydei was saying something to Kokopo the Third, probably cooing to it with the same gentle voice that he had praised Phainon with-

Their gazes meet. Phainon feels his throat tighten, heat prickling at his neck. A long, wet appendage swipes at his cheek and he flinches, turning around to face Norma, who was staring at him with beady eyes, licking at his cheek again.

“Yeah – yeah, big guy. I have your snack right here.”

Phainon tries to focus on feeding the dromas for the next while until he hears footsteps approach, the scent of pomegranates and iron filling his nose as Mydei rests his chin on his shoulder.

“You really do have a habit of feeding with your hands, don’t you Deliverer?”

Phainon clears his throat and continues feeding the soil to Norma while Mydei pets its snout, trying not to be too conscious of the way his scent that gradually enveloped them both, the way his heat seeped through the thick material of his coat to let itself be felt

When Phainon finally turns around, Mydei was already a good distance away, leaving him with nothing but a red face and something fragile and softer curling up inside his chest. Something he would no longer have to deny.
